name: CoA item scaling: a quest reward under native item scaling is not copied
contract: Requires CoA.ItemScaling=1, CoA.ItemScaling.Native=1, DestinyWeaver.Enable=1 and CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1.

A level-32 viewer plays quest 9146 (authored at 12) at 28 on its QuestTemplateScaling.dbc row and receives Farstrider's Tunic 23405, which has no ItemStat.dbc ladder. The old copy lift would have replaced it with a copy at item level 27.
While native item scaling is active the copy path makes no new copies, so the viewer carries the authored tunic at item level 12.
